Subject: Unexpected charge after free credits & VAT on invoice

Hi Grace,

We signed up for Redwood via the self-serve flow on Oct 1 and were granted the advertised free credits. However, our finance team noticed a charge on Oct 3 for token usage (see attached screenshot). We believed the free credits would cover initial usage — can you explain why we were billed?

Also: we need a VAT-compliant invoice showing our EU VAT ID (FR123456789) for this charge. Can you either: 1) reverse the charge if it was applied in error, or 2) provide a corrected invoice that includes VAT details so we can book the expense?

Account: FinTrio Analytics
HubSpot: FT-4321

Thanks,
Elena Moreno
Head of Data Platforms
FinTrio Analytics

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected charge after free credits & VAT on invoice

Hi Elena — thanks for flagging this and sorry for the confusion. Quick summary of what likely happened: when free credits are applied at signup they are consumed first, but the account also has a billing window that can autoclose or apply charges if usage exceeds the credited amount or if the credits expire. I pulled the ledger and it shows a small peak on Oct 3 that exceeded the remaining credit balance.

I've looped in Ben from finance to confirm whether this was an automated charge (and whether we can reverse it). In parallel, we can reissue a VAT-compliant invoice for the charge once Ben confirms the tax treatment.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben: please confirm whether we can issue a provisional credit for the Oct 3 charge while we sort VAT.
- Elena: can you confirm the exact VAT ID you want on the invoice and the billing contact? You included FR123456789 — is that the correct one?

As a gesture for the friction, I'm prepared to add a small one-time credit to extend your trial credits for 7 days after we resolve billing (no charge to you) if you'd like us to cover the shortfall while we investigate.

I'll follow up once Ben confirms.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive — Self-Serve & PLG
Redwood Inference

Hi all — I reviewed the charge and ledger for FinTrio. Summary:
- Charge on 2026-10-03 (USD 134.20) was applied after their free credits were exhausted on a burst request.
- The charge was processed through our EU VAT flow; it currently reflects VAT applied at the default rate because the invoice didn't include the customer's VAT number at the time of billing.

I've taken the following actions:
1) Issued a provisional credit of USD 134.20 while we obtain the VAT documentation (you should see a credit entry on the account).
2) Generated a corrected invoice that includes the VAT number you provided (attached). The corrected file is: corrected-invoice-FT-20261003.pdf.
3) If you prefer a full reversal rather than a provisional credit, let me know and we'll reverse the payment and refund the card; otherwise the provisional credit will offset the billed amount and show as a negative charge on the next statement.

Elena — please confirm the billing contact email for the official invoice (billing@fintrio.com is fine) and whether you need the invoice delivered to a specific person or accounting system.

Links: HubSpot ticket FT-4321 and the internal billing note are attached for audit.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
